title: Rav Chinena bar Chiya
author: Aharon Hyman

paragraphs: In [Ketubot 21a](https://www.sefaria.org/Ketubot.21a.10-11) he objects to Rav Yehudah: “Did Shmuel say this? What about the document issued by Mar Shmuel’s court?” etc. [Jerusalem Talmud Pesachim, at the beginning of chapter 3](https://www.sefaria.org/Jerusalem_Talmud_Pesachim.2.7.6), has Rabbi Chanina, son of Rabbi Bechayi. Hyman suggests son of Rav Chiya, with the bet displaced. Hyman cites [the Rosh on Pesachim 2:13](https://www.sefaria.org/Rosh_on_Pesachim.2.13.1) as reading Rabbi Chanina ben Pedai asking Rabbi Mana.

notes.text: The linked Yerushalmi passage is in chapter 2, halakhah 7. There Rabbi Chanina son of Rabbi Kihai asks Rabbi Mana. Hyman gives Bechayi and proposes that a displaced bet obscured “son of Rav Chiya.”

The linked Rosh has Chanina son of Pedai ask Rabbi Ami. In the preceding account in the Rosh, Shmuel bar Rav Yitzchak asks Rabbi Mana. In Ketubot, Rav Chinena bar Chiya asks Rav Yehudah, as [Heilprin](https://www.girsology.com/seder-hadorot.html?entry=1443&lang=en) notes. Ketubot also gives Huna bar Yehudah and Chiya bar Yehudah as alternative questioners.
